name: Weeping Angels
summary: A free short 3D first-person mobile horror game where you walk through a maze-like environment in search for a key and a "time machine" while avoiding living statues (known as "weeping angels" due to their mourning angel statue appearance) that only move when you're not looking at them. If you let them (by turning your back on them or getting too close) they will kill you. A loose adaptation of Doctor Who's "Weeping Angels". As with many other ScottyAnimation games, there were many different versions, with the first one (1.0) currently being lost.
